findings.evidence: FR-023, AV-4, hosting contract Route group rule 2 and Lifetimes rule 4: T034 found that minimal APIs bind a route handler's service parameters before the group's endpoint filters run, so an endpoint in an Iskender group taking GatewayExecutionContext as a parameter fails with core.context.not_resolved (src/Iskender.Hosting/IskenderEndpointRouteBuilderExtensions.cs adds RequestBootstrap as an endpoint filter; tests resolve the context from RequestServices). The limit is stated only in T034's result in tasks.md: neither the hosting contract's Known limits nor the docs/04 Embedding guide records it, so a later ingress spec relying on the contract would not see it. Gap type partial. T047.
